mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order_dlq_log (order_id, payload, fail_reason, fail_count, status, last_failed_at) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{payload}, #{failReason}, 1, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload = VALUES(payload), fail_reason = VALUES(fail_reason), fail_count = fail_count + 1, status = 0, last_failed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, republished_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, payload, fail_reason, fail_count, status, last_failed_at, republished_at, created_at, updated_at FROM t_order_dlq_log WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY last_failed_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order_dlq_log SET status = 1, republished_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order_dlq_log SET fail_reason = #{failReason}, fail_count = fail_count + 1, last_failed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE t_order_dlq_log SET status = 2, fail_reason = #{failReason}, fail_count = #{failCount}, last_failed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
